trigger: US debt / yield concerns amid positive overnight equities
magnitude: Moderate mixed: Moody's downgrade background; GIFT flat at 06:30.
reason: Higher US yields can pressure EM valuations, but the overnight equity rebound opposed negative close. Downgrade was older news; no fresh negative shock uniquely identified.
timing: Mint 20 May 07:32 IST; NDTV quote 06:30; downgrade treated as background.

trigger: Mixed global risk signals; possible rebound after domestic selloff
magnitude: Low/mixed: US S&P snapped six-session rally; Asian equities firmer; GIFT about +24 points.
reason: Asian resilience could support Indian buying, but US yield concerns pull opposite way. No discrete positive external surprise verified.
timing: 21 May morning digest; exact publication time not shown in retrieved excerpt.

trigger: US fiscal-deficit fears and global bond selloff
magnitude: High/moderate negative: Wall Street fell sharply as bond yields rose.
reason: Higher global discount rates and fiscal uncertainty reduce appetite for equities and EM assets; plausible channel for Indian decline.
timing: 22 May 07:26 IST report documents 21 May US selloff.

trigger: Asian rebound / stabilising US equities; modest India growth upgrade

reason: A slightly firmer growth outlook and regional risk appetite can support valuations; small forecast revision alone unlikely to explain whole gain.
timing: Mint overnight article published 23 May 2025 07:01 IST; growth-forecast revision and early Asian gains documented before cutoff.

trigger: Trump delayed threatened EU tariff hike
magnitude: High positive relief: proposed 50% tariff delayed from 1 June to 9 July.
reason: Reduced near-term trade-war risk supports global equities and Indian risk appetite. RBI dividend / early monsoon are older supplementary background.
timing: Announcement Sunday 25 May US evening / early 26 May IST; Asia trading reaction corroborates pre-Indian-open availability.

trigger: Subdued Asian equities; no new US cash close due to holiday
magnitude: Low negative/mixed: Nikkei -0.2%, Kospi -0.44%; weak dollar supportive.
reason: Weak regional sentiment can encourage position reduction, but no major negative economic shock verified. Profit taking is a plausible inference after gains.
timing: 27 May 08:09 IST premarket report; US Memorial Day holiday explains absence of overnight cash cue.

trigger: Trade-war / US growth concerns despite positive overnight equities

reason: Softer US activity can lower yields and support EM valuations, but also threatens exporter demand. RBI easing expectations supportive; next-day policy outcome not yet known.

magnitude: Moderate anticipation; weak US equities / Tesla-Musk dispute offset.
reason: Policy expectations can support rate-sensitive sectors, but actual 50bp repo cut and CRR package were announced during session. They cannot be qualifying premarket triggers for the +1.019% close.

reason: Higher oil increases India's import/inflation burden; geopolitical risk raises discount rates. Air India crash occurred later 12 Jun and is excluded.

trigger: Israel attacked Iran; oil / geopolitical risk repriced
magnitude: High negative: GIFT -0.86%, about -212 points before open.
reason: Conflict escalation threatens regional energy supply and India's import bill; risk aversion pressures equity valuations. Previous-day aviation crash is secondary, not sufficient for broad-index causality.
timing: 13 Jun 08:07 IST premarket report explicitly identifies attacks already underway.

trigger: Positive premarket equities despite continuing Israel-Iran attacks
magnitude: High geopolitical risk but mixed market cue: GIFT +0.3%, about +65 points.
reason: Resilience may reflect belief oil flows will continue and bargain buying; ongoing conflict itself is adverse. No clear positive external surprise verified.
timing: Upstox 16 Jun 08:49 IST; Sunday / overnight conflict news eligible but cannot establish positive close.

trigger: RBI finalised softer project-finance norms; geopolitical caution persists
magnitude: Moderate positive regulatory relief; final rules remove stricter draft overhang.
reason: Lower expected provisioning burden can support lenders and infrastructure financing; NIFTY effect indirect and competing conflict risks remain.
timing: RBI directions published 19 Jun; 20 Jun 09:19 report corroborates earlier rules. Same-day gains are outcomes.

magnitude: High negative: three nuclear sites targeted; WTI opened about USD 3.07 higher at USD 78.
reason: Direct US entry raises escalation/Hormuz supply risk and India's oil import exposure; plausible dominant negative shock.
timing: Strikes early 22 Jun; oil reopening 22 Jun US / early 23 Jun IST. NDTV premarket 23 Jun 06:50 IST.

trigger: Israel-Iran ceasefire relief; oil eased and US stocks rallied
reason: Lower oil-supply risk benefits India's external balance and inflation outlook; lower risk premia can support equities. Ceasefire fragility limits certainty.
timing: 25 Jun 08:00 IST report covers 24 Jun oil decline / US rally following ceasefire.

reason: Contained oil disruption and softer dollar can favour Indian valuations and capital flows. No comparable fresh shock; expiry positioning may amplify but is unproven.
